exponent: She became a well-known exponent of healthy eating in her community.
她成了社区里倡导健康饮食的知名人士。
disciple: The old painter had many young disciples who studied under him for years.
这位老画家有许多跟随他学习了多年的年轻弟子。
backlighting: The photographer used backlighting to make the trees look soft and bright.
摄影师运用逆光使树木显得柔和明亮。
insistence: At his insistence, we finally changed the meeting to a later time.
在他的坚持下，我们最终把会议改到了更晚的时间。
corona: During the eclipse, the bright corona around the sun amazed everyone.
日食期间，太阳周围明亮的光环让所有人惊叹。
midterm: She stayed up late to review her notes for the midterm exam.
她熬夜复习笔记，准备期中考试。
clipper: Long ago, a fast clipper could cross the ocean in record time.
很久以前，快速帆船能以创纪录的时间横渡大洋。
ductile: Copper is a ductile metal, so it can be drawn into thin wires.
铜是一种有延展性的金属，因此可以被拉成细丝。
accede: The young prince will accede to the throne after the old king retires.
老国王退位后，年轻的王子将继承王位。
vivify: A few colorful flowers can vivify an otherwise plain garden.
几株色彩鲜艳的花就能让原本单调的花园充满生气。
notate: Musicians notate a melody with symbols so that others can play it.
音乐家用符号来记录旋律，以便他人演奏。
fresco: The artist painted a beautiful fresco on the wall of the old church.
这位艺术家在老教堂的墙上绘制了一幅精美的湿壁画。
artesian: The village gets its water from an artesian well beneath the hill.
这个村庄的用水来自山下的自流井。
soprano: Her voice is clear and high, which makes her a fine soprano.
她的嗓音清澈高亢，因此成为一名出色的女高音。
degenerative: Regular exercise may slow some degenerative diseases in older people.
经常锻炼可以延缓老年人的一些退行性疾病。
trilogy: The author spent ten years writing her famous science fiction trilogy.
这位作者花了十年时间写就她著名的科幻三部曲。
pertain: These rules pertain to anyone who uses the school laboratory.
这些规定适用于所有使用学校实验室的人。
bicameral: The country has a bicameral parliament made up of two separate houses.
该国实行两院制议会，由两个独立的议院组成。
tremulous: The old man spoke in a tremulous voice as he told his story.
老人讲述自己的故事时声音微微颤抖。
credence: New evidence gave credence to the witness's unusual account.
新的证据使证人的不同寻常的陈述更加可信。
roe: The fish lays thousands of eggs, but much of the roe is eaten by other animals.
这种鱼会产下数千颗卵，但大部分鱼卵会被其他动物吃掉。
octopus: An octopus can change its color to hide from enemies on the seafloor.
章鱼能改变自身的颜色，以便在海床躲避敌人。
sunlit: The cat loves to sleep in the sunlit corner of the living room.
这只猫喜欢睡在客厅里阳光照射的角落。
deviant: The study examined behavior that society once considered deviant.
这项研究考察了社会曾经视为反常的行为。
concentric: The stone made concentric circles as it sank into the quiet pond.
石头沉入平静的池塘时激起了同心的涟漪。
labyrinth: The tourists got lost in the labyrinth of narrow streets.
游客们在如迷宫般狭窄的街道中迷了路。
aquatic: Whales and dolphins are aquatic animals that live their whole lives in water.
鲸鱼和海豚是终生生活在水中的水生动物。
modeling: Good modeling in a drawing makes flat shapes look solid and real.
绘画中出色的立体感处理能让平面的图形显得真实立体。
meteorological: The meteorological report warns of heavy rain across the whole region.
气象报告警告整个地区将有大雨。
scavenger: The fox is a scavenger that will eat almost anything it finds.
狐狸是一种食腐动物，几乎找到什么就吃什么。
resin: The pine tree produces a sticky resin that protects its broken bark.
松树会分泌一种黏稠的树脂来保护破损的树皮。
feudal: In feudal times, most farmers worked land that belonged to a lord.
在封建时代，大多数农民耕种属于领主的土地。
constricted: She felt constricted by the strict rules of the small town.
小镇的严格规矩让她感到备受束缚。
indigent: The clinic offers free treatment to indigent families in the area.
这家诊所为当地的贫困家庭提供免费治疗。
operant: The operant conditions in the experiment shaped how the animals behaved.
实验中的操作性条件塑造了动物的行为方式。
eclecticism: The restaurant's menu shows an eclecticism that mixes dishes from many cultures.
这家餐厅的菜单体现了融合多种文化菜肴的折中主义。
polygamy: Polygamy is not accepted in most modern legal systems.
大多数现代法律体系都不接受多配偶制。
pendant: She wore a small silver pendant that her grandmother had given her.
她戴着一条祖母送的小银质坠饰。
plankton: Whales swim through the sea with mouths open to feed on plankton.
鲸鱼张着嘴在海中游动，以浮游生物为食。
deductive: Sherlock Holmes is famous for his deductive method of solving cases.
夏洛克·福尔摩斯以他演绎推理的破案方法而闻名。
